Senses.Explanation: Literally, 'host within guest.' In the later systematic account of Linji's four guest-host configurations, this is the configuration named when 'the student has nostrils' (學人有鼻孔, 'the student has nostrils'). Records then raise the label as a public question and preserve different answers, including 'facing him, there is no companion.' This is one member of the fourfold set alongside host-within-host, guest-within-host, and guest-within-guest. The texts explicitly say that Linji's guest-host system differs from Caodong's, so the shared graphs must not blur the two school-specific things.
Senses.Note: Primary sense because the wave groups the term with Linji's four guest-host configurations. Family check with the four guest-host configurations (四賓主) and guest and host (賓主) preserves its explicit nostrils-definition and the stated contrast with Caodong. Split is required under §5 #0f.8: the corpus says the identically written category belongs to two different named systems.

Occurrences.Kwic: 如何是賓中主。穴云。入市雙瞳瞽。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 人天眼目. The exact actor is an unnamed monk: 僧問風穴 introduces 如何是賓中主. No personal name remains after the six-rung review.

Occurrences.Kwic: 曰如何是賓中主。師曰。對面無儔侶。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Fenyang Shanzhao section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what guest within host is, and Fenyang answers that face-to-face there is no companion. All six rungs preserve no personal name for the monk.

Senses.Explanation: In Caodong guest-host discourse the same words name a position paired with host-within-guest's converse and with the bent-and-upright vocabulary. The Eye of Humans and Gods explicitly glosses Caodong's host-within-guest as 'function within essence' (用中體) and says this fourfold guest-host system is not the same as Linji's. In the Dongshan encounter, Dongshan asks 'what is host within guest?' and receives 'white clouds cover the green mountain'; another transmitted version assigns 'long years not leaving the house.' Later verse can say 'host within guest is precisely guest within host' and tell the hearer not to recognize a fixed pattern in reversal and accord. These are recorded formulas and answers, not an invitation to supply an interpretation beyond them.
Senses.Note: Separate school-specific referent, not a competing reading of one saying. Variant answers are retained as deployments within the Caodong positional category and are not split further.

Occurrences.Kwic: 洞山便問：「如何是賓中主？」云：「白雲蓋青山。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dongshan asks the positional question and receives 'white clouds cover the green mountain.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 如何是賓中主。師曰。長年不出戶。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Longshan encounter. Dongshan Liangjie is the exact questioner who asks what host within guest is; Longshan answers, 'long years not leaving the house.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 賓中主即主中賓，逆順縱橫莫認真
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 天如惟則禪師語錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Tianru Weize as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四賓主。不同臨濟。主中賓。體中用也。賓中主。用中體也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 人天眼目: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Huiyan Zhizhao as the actor for this occurrence.
